summary: Frontend-only independent validation completed for NOVA portrait migration on Login and Bugün/Dashboard. Login (1920x1080, 390x844) and Dashboard (1920x1080, 390x844) passed portrait visibility, real image load, 3:4 frame ratio, Hazır status label, no orb residue, and no horizontal overflow checks. Workspace snapshot was fetched from live backend and showed connected Google Calendar/Sheets sources with no mock markers.
action_items: No blocker found for requested portrait replacement scope.
Optional: keep CSP console noise review separately (Cloudflare beacon/worker blocked), as it did not affect requested UI flows.
critical_code_review_comments: NovaPortrait uses fixed /nova-portrait.webp source and frame-level aspect-ratio: 3/4, which reliably enforces visual ratio even when original asset ratio differs.
LoginPage and BugunPage both use explicit data-testid hooks for portrait and status elements, keeping automation stable.
No orb-related class/id/testid residue found in tested Login and daily briefing DOM scopes.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary signed nova_session for linked Google user via /app/backend/tests/session_helper.py and deleted only that temporary session after testing.

rca of the issue: No regression reproduced. Requested replacement behaves as intended in tested breakpoints: portrait component renders with correct source and state labels, and old orb artifact was not present in scoped DOM checks.
